notes.title: Happy Halloween Update! New Jack the Pumpkin Character and Fixes
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween Vegetaball fans! We've been working hard to improve and fix the issues you have brought to our attention.

To celebrate the holiday we created a new playable character [b]Jack the Pumpkin[/b]. The pumpkin people only get psychic powers once a year, but Jack has mastered the flow of the seasons and can compete in the Vegedome year-round.

Update v1.03 is now [b]LIVE[/b]. There are some minor gameplay changes that mostly affect how platforms function. Here are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added Jack the Pumpkin Character
[*] Increased maximum party size to 8 players
[*] Added In-game kick player vote system
[*] Changed the design of how in-game individual player scores are displayed
[*] Fixed some localization issues on Main Menu UI Elements
[*] Changed Platform functionality to only raise when player is colliding with platform
[/list]

Player feedback has really helped our team make this game the best it can be. If you have any suggestions or are aware of a bug please inform us by filling out a ticket here: [url=https://gammagamesinteractive.com/support-center/]https://gammagamesinteractive.com/support-center/[/url]

notes.title: Vegetaball is now AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody!

We're happy to announce that Vegetaball is now LIVE!

If you've played the game please write a review for us. We would love to hear your feedback.

Please be patient as we build our new player-base and implement bots to help populate games.


We look forward to seeing you in the Vegedome ːsteamhappyː
